title: Bioprospection of Piliostigma thonningii ethanol extract for anti-fibroid activity via molecular docking and in vivo hormonal evaluation in female wistar rats.
authors: Ogah, Chinenye Florence; Olokun, Alexander; Ejiofor, Daniel; Gyebi, Gideon Ampoma; Anyanwu, Gabriel Oluwabunmi
journal: The Journal of steroid biochemistry and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接评估植物提取物与雌激素/孕激素受体的结合，但对象为小分子-蛋白受体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，仅常规对接，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study investigated anti-fibroid potential of Piliostigma thonningii leaf extract using in vivo hormonal and histopathological evaluations of the ethanolic extract in female wistar rats complimented by in silico molecular docking of phytochemical compounds. In vivo fibroid induction with diethylstilbestrol and progesterone significantly increased serum estradiol and progesterone levels (p < 0.05), accompanied by cystic degenerative changes in uterine and ovarian tissues. Treatment with P. thonningii crude extract (250 and 500 mg/kg) significantly reduced elevated hormone levels as well as showed observable improvements in uterine gross morphology and histopathological features. Molecular docking of thirty-one phytoconstituents identified via GCMS profiling of the plant's crude ethanol extract were docked at the ligand-binding domains of progesterone receptor (PR, PDB ID: 4OAR) and estrogen receptor (ER, PDB ID: 1QKU) using AutoDock Vina to explore possible mechanistic interactions. Among the top-ranked compounds, cyclopropaneoctanal-2-octyl exhibited favorable predicted binding interactions with key catalytic residue for PR (CYS(891) and THR(894)) and ER catalytic residue (HIS(524)) comparable to the reference ligands ulipristal acetate and estrogen. Drug-likeness and ADMET prediction suggested that this compound possess acceptable pharmacokinetic properties and dynamic stability. These findings indicate that P. thonningii extract exerts anti-fibroid effects in vivo while in silico analysis provide mechanistic hypotheses regarding the potential contribution of the individual compounds to estrogen and progesterone receptor modulation.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过体内激素和组织病理学评估，探讨了Piliostigma thonningii叶提取物在雌性Wistar大鼠中的抗纤维瘤潜力，并辅以植物化学化合物的分子对接 (molecular docking) 分析。使用己烯雌酚和黄体酮进行体内纤维瘤诱导，显著增加了血清雌二醇和黄体酮水平（p < 0.05），并伴随子宫和卵巢组织的囊性退行性变化。用P. thonningii粗提物（250和500 mg/kg）治疗显著降低了升高的激素水平，并在子宫大体形态和组织病理学特征上显示出可观察的改善。通过GCMS分析植物粗乙醇提取物鉴定出的三十一种植物成分，使用AutoDock Vina对接至孕激素受体（PR, PDB ID: 4OAR）和雌激素受体（ER, PDB ID: 1QKU）的配体结合域，以探索可能的机制性相互作用。在排名靠前的化合物中，cyclopropaneoctanal-2-octyl显示出与PR关键催化残基（CYS(891)和THR(894)）及ER催化残基（HIS(524)）的有利预测结合相互作用，与参考配体醋酸乌利司他和雌激素相当。药物相似性和ADMET预测表明，该化合物具有可接受的药代动力学特性和动态稳定性。这些发现表明，P. thonningii提取物在体内发挥抗纤维瘤作用，而计算机模拟分析为各化合物对雌激素和孕激素受体调节的潜在贡献提供了机制性假设。
